layout.hierarchy: The upper half is visually dominant: the cyan implication box (left) and the colorful network diagram (right) carry the most saturated color. The lower half is mostly white space with thin blue-bordered panels; the long chain-rule equation is the widest single element on the slide, while the four-line derivative panel on the lower right is the densest text block. Color coding drives attention: red '⇒' arrows, green final results, magenta/red subscripts, and blue Net_k rectangles.

visual_elements.description: Neural-network / back-propagation schematic on a tan background. Far left: a vertical column of four small magenta filled dots (the input/sample-data nodes). Moving right, six vertical columns of small circles, three circles per column (one per row): column 1 = red-outlined circles containing a red 'Σ'; column 2 = red-outlined circles containing a red italic 'f'; column 3 = blue-outlined circles containing a blue 'f'; column 4 = green-outlined circles containing a green 'Σ'; column 5 = yellow-filled circles with orange outline containing an orange 'f'; column 6 = orange-filled circles with orange outline containing an orange 'Σ'. The three rows are densely interconnected by thin straight lines in magenta/pink, blue, green and orange, forming a fully-connected mesh between adjacent columns. At the right of column 6 are three dark-blue filled rectangles with white text: 'Net_{k=1}' (top row), 'Net_{k=2}' (middle row), 'Net_{k=3}' (bottom row). Immediately right of them is a tall vertical dark-red bar spanning all three rows with white bold text 'Error' rotated 90°. To the right of that bar are three green labels aligned with the rows: 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'. Dashed dependency arcs: a black dashed arc over the top from the green Σ column to the orange Σ column, a blue dashed arc over the top from the orange Σ column to the Net_k rectangles, a blue dashed arc under the bottom from the orange Σ column to the Net_k rectangles, and a black dashed arc under the bottom from the green Σ column to the orange Σ column. Along the bottom edge of the diagram, left to right: a small magenta filled dot followed by the magenta text 'Sample Data'; a hollow light-blue upward arrow under the blue 'f' column; a magenta filled circle containing a white '1'; a hollow green upward arrow under the green Σ column; a second magenta filled circle containing a white '1'; and an orange 'X' under the orange Σ column.

Pale-cyan rectangle with thin blue border containing four lines of black bold-italic serif text: 'W_β Affects Net_j ⇒', 'Net_j Affects O_j ⇒', 'O_j Affects (Net_{k=1}, Net_{k=2}, ..., Net_{k=m}) ⇒', '(Net_{k=1}, Net_{k=2}, ..., Net_{k=m}) Affect Error'. Each of the first three lines ends with a red '⇒' arrow; the fourth line ends with the words 'Affect Error' and no arrow.

Large white rectangle with thin blue border containing one long chain-rule equation across its top: '∂E/∂w_β = [∂E/∂Net_{k=1} · ∂Net_{k=1}/∂O_j] + [∂E/∂Net_{k=2} · ∂Net_{k=2}/∂O_j] + ... + [∂E/∂Net_{k=m} · ∂Net_{k=m}/∂O_j] · [∂O_j/∂Net_j] · [∂Net_j/∂w_β]'. The subscripts 'k=1', 'k=2' and 'k=m' are colored red/magenta while the rest is black. The remainder of the panel is empty white space.

White rectangle with thin blue border containing four stacked equations: (1) '∂E/∂Net_k ⇒ -δ_k' with red arrow and green '-δ_k'; (2) 'Net_j = Σ_i w_ij O_j ⇒ ∂Net_j/∂O_j = w_ij' with red arrow; (3) 'O_j = 1/(1+e^{-Net_j}) ⇒ ∂O_j/∂Net_j = O_j(1-O_j)' with the sigmoid written as a stacked fraction and a red arrow; (4) 'Net_j = Σ_j w_ij O_j ⇒ ∂Net_j/∂w_ij = O_i' with a red arrow.
Slide-number badge: yellow filled circle with a magenta/purple circular outline containing the black numeral '19'.
Thin dark-red rectangular outline framing the entire slide, inset roughly 4% from each edge.

typography_notes: All text is serif (Times New Roman / Cambria-style). The four statements in the top-left cyan box are bold italic, with variables (W_β, Net_j, O_j, Net_{k=1}...) in bold italic and the connecting words ('Affects', 'Affect', 'Error') also bold italic; the '⇒' arrows are red and non-italic. Equations use serif math italic for variables with true subscripts; the chain-rule equation is a single long line with bracketed fractions and centered dots as separators, with red/magenta subscripts 'k=1', 'k=2', 'k=m'. In the lower-right panel the implication arrows are red and the first result '-δ_k' is green. Diagram node labels (Σ, f) are italic serif in the node colors; 'Net_{k=1..3}' are white bold serif on blue rectangles; 'Error' is white bold rotated 90°; 'Class 1 / Class 2 / Class m' are green bold serif; 'Sample Data' is small magenta serif.
animation_state: No visible mid-build state; all four implication statements, the full network diagram, the complete chain-rule equation and all four derivative equations are simultaneously visible. The slide is fully rendered (slide number 19).
